_readme: Draft content for the AJ's Bakery flavor detail sheets. Nutrition is a CALCULATED ESTIMATE per cookie from the RD1 recipes, using the printed label values of Callebaut 811, Anchor unsalted butter, Kinder Maxi and Kinder Bueno, and standard values for flour, sugars, eggs, cocoa powder and vanilla (brands not recorded). Not lab tested. Allergens and ingredient lists follow those products' labels. VERIFY everything in each flavor's 'verify' list before launch. Copy is written in a plain, casual voice; edit freely.
global_allergen_note: Made in a home kitchen that also handles milk, egg, wheat, soy, hazelnuts and peanuts. If you have a serious allergy, message us before ordering.
nutrition_note: Estimated per cookie. Calculated from our recipe and the labels of the ingredients we use, not lab tested. Actual values vary a little with each batch.

callebaut_811.source: Barry Callebaut spec (kcal, fat, protein); carbs and sugars from UK distributor spec sheets of the same recipe 811

anchor_unsalted_butter.source: Anchor unsalted butter 200g UK pack label

dutch_cocoa_powder.source: standard value for alkalized cocoa, brand not recorded

nutella.source: Ferrero Nutella label (standard EU values), PH jar not checked

lotus_biscoff_spread.source: approximate Lotus Biscoff crunchy spread label, PH jar not checked

lotus_biscoff_cookies.source: Lotus Biscoff biscuit label (standard EU values), PH pack not checked

skippy_creamy_peanut_butter.source: Skippy creamy US label (190 kcal per 32g), PH jar not checked

reeses_milk_chocolate_peanut_butter.source: approximate Reese's label, Giant bar pack not checked

banana_ripe_raw.source: standard value for raw banana; cooking it down only loses water

eggs_1_whole_plus_1_yolk.source: standard value for the whole batch quantity (not per 100g)

vanilla_extract_1_5_tsp.source: standard value for the whole batch quantity (not per 100g)

flavors.name: Chimp Chips
flavors.short_description: Nutty brown butter packed with Callebaut dark chocolate. Soft, chewy, and the one to start with.
flavors.long_description: This is the one to start with. We brown the butter until it smells like toasted caramel, then load the dough with chopped Callebaut dark chocolate, the Belgian chocolate bakers love. Soft and chewy, with a nutty, buttery edge and chocolate in every bite.
flavors.ingredients: All-purpose wheat flour, dark chocolate (cocoa mass, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural vanilla flavouring), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, baking soda, salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.
verify: Check your Callebaut 811 pack against the values used (550 kcal, 36.6g fat, 5.1g protein per 100g from Barry Callebaut; 45.8g carbs and 43.1g sugars from UK distributor sheets of the same recipe). Update if your pack differs.
Check your Anchor butter pack matches the UK 200g label (744 kcal, 82g fat per 100g).
Flour, sugars, eggs and vanilla use standard values because the brands aren't recorded. Add the brands if you want it tighter.
Weigh 5 baked cookies and use the average. 60g is dough weight; baked weight is a bit lower. Per-cookie nutrition stays the same as long as you portion 60g each.

flavors.name: Coco Loco
flavors.short_description: Dutch cocoa dough with Callebaut dark chocolate chunks. Rich, deep, and not bitter.
flavors.long_description: Made for people who take chocolate seriously. Dutch cocoa goes into the dough, then chunks of Callebaut dark chocolate on top of that, all on our brown butter base. Dutch cocoa is the mellow kind, so it's dark and rich without the harsh bitterness. Best with cold milk.
flavors.ingredients: All-purpose wheat flour, dark chocolate (cocoa mass, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural vanilla flavouring), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, sugar, eggs, Dutch-process cocoa powder, vanilla extract, baking soda, salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.
verify: Same Callebaut 811 and Anchor checks as Chimp Chips.
The 500g Dutch cocoa powder from All About Baking: read its pack for brand, per-100g nutrition and any allergen line. I used a standard alkalized cocoa value (228 kcal per 100g).
Weigh 5 baked cookies and use the average.

flavors.name: Bueno Mucho
flavors.short_description: Half a Kinder Bueno hidden inside, with Kinder Maxi chocolate in the dough. Our biggest cookie.
flavors.long_description: The fun one. Brown butter dough loaded with chopped Kinder Maxi chocolate, wrapped around half a Kinder Bueno bar. Bite in and you hit wafer crunch and hazelnut cream. It's our biggest cookie at about 70g, and the wafer goes soft after a few days, so eat it within 2-3 days.
flavors.ingredients: Kinder Bueno (milk chocolate, sugar, palm oil, wheat flour, hazelnuts, milk powder, soy lecithin), all-purpose wheat flour, Kinder Maxi milk chocolate (sugar, milk powder, cocoa butter, cocoa mass, palm oil, soy lecithin), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, baking soda, salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.

_calc.note: Dough is 60g per cookie like the other flavors (about 900g per batch = 15 cookies). Center is half a 21.5g Kinder Bueno bar (changed from a whole bar on Oct 11). Per cookie = dough + half of per_bueno_piece (kcal 295.5 + 61.5 = 357).

verify: Same Anchor check as Chimp Chips.

Read the Kinder Maxi pack (I used Ferrero's label: 566 kcal, 35g fat, 53.5g carbs, 53.3g sugars, 8.7g protein per 100g) and the Kinder Bueno pack (572 kcal, 37.3g fat, 49.5g carbs, 41.2g sugars, 8.6g protein per 100g). Update if your PH packs differ.
Confirm the center piece weighs about 10.75g (half of a 21.5g bar) and weigh 5 baked cookies. Dough is 60g plus the center, so roughly 71g before baking loss.
Confirm the shelf life of 2-3 days (the wafer goes soft first) by testing Day 1, 2, 3 and 4 on a batch you keep.

flavors.name: Banana Bread
flavors.short_description: Banana bread in cookie form: ripe banana, a little cinnamon and Callebaut dark chocolate on our brown butter base.
flavors.long_description: Everything you love about a warm slice of banana bread, squeezed into a cookie. We cook down very ripe bananas so the flavor gets deep and jammy, add a pinch of cinnamon, then fold in Callebaut dark chocolate. Soft, cozy and a little nostalgic.
flavors.ingredients: All-purpose wheat flour, dark chocolate (cocoa mass, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural vanilla flavouring), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, ripe banana, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, cinnamon, baking soda, salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.

_calc.recipe: base with 237g flour + 130g ripe banana (cooked down) + 150g Callebaut 811 + 1/2 tsp cinnamon

verify: ROUGH PLACEHOLDER from the RD1 draft recipe, before the first test bake. Replace everything with final values after testing.
Banana amount and flour are still guesses in RD1: recalculate once the recipe is locked.
Shelf life of 3-4 days is a guess (banana makes it moister): test Day 1-5.
Pick the final menu name (the recipe notes say to name it before launch).

flavors.name: Nutella
flavors.short_description: A melty Nutella center hiding inside brown butter dough with Callebaut dark chocolate, finished with flaky salt.
flavors.long_description: For the Nutella-from-the-jar crowd. Each cookie hides a frozen disc of Nutella that melts into a gooey hazelnut chocolate center as it bakes, wrapped in our brown butter dough with chopped Callebaut dark chocolate. A pinch of flaky salt on top keeps it from being too sweet.
flavors.ingredients: All-purpose wheat flour, Nutella (sugar, palm oil, hazelnuts, skimmed milk powder, fat-reduced cocoa, soy lecithin, vanillin), dark chocolate (cocoa mass, sugar, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural vanilla flavouring), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, baking soda, salt, flaky sea salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.

_calc.recipe: base + 150g Callebaut 811 + 225g Nutella (15 x 15g discs); flaky salt and any topper not counted

verify: ROUGH PLACEHOLDER from the RD1 draft recipe, before the first test bake. Replace everything with final values after testing.
If you add a Nutella biscuit topper, add it to the ingredients and nutrition.
Check the Nutella jar label from S&R against the values used.
Shelf life of 3-4 days is a guess: test it.

flavors.name: Biscoff
flavors.short_description: Brown butter dough with crushed Lotus biscuits and a gooey cookie butter center. Warm, spiced and caramel-y.
flavors.long_description: Cookie butter lovers, this one's yours. Crushed Lotus Biscoff biscuits go into our brown butter dough with a little cinnamon, and every cookie hides a frozen disc of Biscoff spread that turns soft and gooey in the oven. Think caramelized, cinnamon-spiced and very hard to share.
flavors.ingredients: All-purpose wheat flour, Biscoff spread (caramelised biscuits (wheat flour, sugar, vegetable oils (palm, rapeseed), candy sugar syrup, raising agent (sodium bicarbonate), soy flour, salt, cinnamon), rapeseed oil, sugar, soy lecithin, citric acid), Lotus Biscoff biscuits (wheat flour, sugar, vegetable oils (palm, rapeseed), candy sugar syrup, raising agent (sodium bicarbonate), soy flour, salt, cinnamon), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, cinnamon, baking soda, salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.

_calc.recipe: base (no chocolate) + 120g crushed Lotus biscuits + 225g Biscoff spread (15 x 15g discs); cinnamon and any topper not counted

verify: ROUGH PLACEHOLDER from the RD1 draft recipe, before the first test bake. Replace everything with final values after testing.
Biscoff is a Lotus trademark: pick your own menu name before this goes much further.
Check the Lotus spread and biscuit labels from S&R (crunchy spread values are approximate).
Shelf life of 3-4 days is a guess: test it.

flavors.name: Peanut Butter Reese's
flavors.short_description: Peanut butter brown butter dough loaded with chopped Reese's. Salty, sweet and very peanutty. Contains peanuts.
flavors.long_description: Made for peanut butter people. Creamy peanut butter goes right into our brown butter dough, then we pack it with chopped Reese's peanut butter cups. Salty-sweet, soft in the middle and seriously peanutty. Please note: this cookie contains peanuts.
flavors.ingredients: All-purpose wheat flour, Reese's milk chocolate peanut butter cups (milk chocolate (sugar, cocoa butter, chocolate, skim milk, milk fat, lactose, soy lecithin, PGPR), peanuts, sugar, dextrose, salt, TBHQ), peanut butter (roasted peanuts, sugar, hydrogenated vegetable oils, salt), brown butter (unsalted butter), dark brown sugar, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, baking soda, salt.
flavors.storage_tip: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature.

_calc.recipe: version A: base with 247g flour + 150g Skippy creamy + 1 Reese's Giant bar (208.9g); no PB center, no mini cup topper
